dct_title_s: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Democratic Republic of the Congo administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 26 Province - Admin 2: 164 Territory / Territorie - Admin 3: 519 Health zone / Zone de santé Note: Officially, there are 145 administrative units. However, to align with the admin3 level—which in practice represents health district areas rather than administrative boundaries—19 admin2 units corresponding to the main cities have been created. Dates associated with this dataset: - 20 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 11 September 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 12 September 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 12 September 2019: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-dr-congo). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
